title: Add fast batch Past Observation and Event Seeder (areas, items, ways, scopes, time-spread, optional parallel LLM weave)

sections.what: Add a fast, lightweight batch Past Observation & Event Seeder (backend + modal UI) that seeds areas, visible items (with tags), and connected ways/lock aspects for 1 or N characters across selected areas or whole scopes, at a past tick or staggered over past days, with optional custom note and parallel per-character LLM voice weaving.
sections.why: Authors placing characters mid-scene (e.g. Miki & Elena in the Mansion library after being locked in the foyer) or populating lived-in sandboxes (e.g. 23 goblins knowing all 18 areas of Kraktooth Camp over days) currently have no UI for handle_mark_visited, no way/lock aspect seeding, no batch/scope/time-spread mode, and no way to combine instant deterministic observations with optional multi-character backstory notes.
sections.how:
1. Add optional world_datetime parameter to Player.record_observation in player.py so seeded and runtime observations carry exact ISO timestamps.
2. Enhance handle_mark_visited in routes/player_ops.py (pass _item_tags on item observations, stamp world_datetime) and add handle_seed_observations (POST /api/world/seed-observations) supporting multi-player, scope-to-areas expansion, areas/items/ways+aspects seeding, single past tick or staggered spread over past N days, optional custom note, and optional StreamStore milestone.
3. Build static/js/stream/seed-observations-modal.ts (modern fluid CSS modal) with multi-character chips (plus All in scope), Scope/Areas picker, time presets + spread-over-days toggle, deterministic checkboxes (Areas/Items/Ways/Timeline milestone), optional custom note, and optional parallel LLM voice-weave grounded in the seeded rooms/items/ways.
4. Wire entry buttons into GraphContextMenu (area right-click) and TimelineView (slot drawer), load script in templates/index.html, compile TS, and add end-to-end pytest coverage in tests/test_seed_observations.py.
sections.verify: pytest tests/test_seed_observations.py tests/test_player_map.py -q and npm run build:ts (0 errors).

acceptance.text: Player.record_observation stamps world_datetime when provided or derivable, keeping time-locked recall and intermediator relative ages accurate.

POST /api/world/seed-observations seeds areas, visible items (with item tags), and visible connected ways + way aspects (locked/blocked/needs_force) for 1 or N characters across selected areas or an entire scope, with single past tick or staggered spread over past N days, zero LLM calls by default.
Optional custom note and optional parallel per-character LLM voice weaving (grounded in room items/ways/entity_ids) work alongside deterministic observation seeding.
Seed Past Observations modal is accessible from Graph area right-click menu and TimelineView, uses modern responsive layout, and updates worldState + TurnMinimap cleanly.

custom.browser_ui:
Intended UI home: Seed Past Observations modal opened from (1) right-clicking an area node in the graph ('Seed Past Observations...') and (2) TimelineView slot drawer ('Seed Past Observations / Event...').

Manual verification steps:
1. Right-click foyer in Mansion -> Seed Past Observations -> select Miki & Elena, 15 min ago, Areas + Items + Ways + optional note -> Apply -> verify both have foyer + front door observations and locked way aspect.
2. In Kraktooth Goblin Camp, open Seed Past Observations -> select scope goblin_camp + All in scope + Spread over past 3 days -> Apply -> verify all goblins have staggered past observations across all camp areas.
